description: Vship (NVIDIA/CUDA build) - GPU-accelerated SSIMULACRA2, Butteraugli and CVVDP metrics as a VapourSynth plugin
notes: This is the CUDA build - it needs an NVIDIA GPU. AMD (HIP) and Vulkan builds exist upstream as separate assets.

The DLL stays in the package directory - link it into your VapourSynth plugin path yourself. Upstream keeps the file name stable, so ...\apps\vp-vship\current\libvship_NVIDIA.dll survives updates as a link target.
Upstream also ships FFVship, a standalone CLI for the same metrics - not included here.
